name: S&P 500 Returns After First Fed Rate Cut of Each Easing Cycle
description: Identifies the first Fed rate cut of each easing cycle since 1990 (defined as a cut preceded by 252+ trading days without a cut). Computes 6-month (126-day) forward SPY returns for each cycle start. Bar chart shows per-cycle returns color-coded by sign. Summary table details each cycle's Fed rate, rate change, and SPY performance. Pre-2003 cycles show N/A for SPY returns.
source:
# =============================================================================
# S&P 500 Returns After First Fed Rate Cut of Each Easing Cycle
# Cycles detected from 1990 onward using DFEDTARU/DFEDTAR stitched series.
# 6-month (126 trading day) forward SPY return per cycle start.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()

# Fed Funds Target Rate: stitch DFEDTARU (2008+) and DFEDTAR (pre-2008)
dfedtaru = economic_indicators(series_id="DFEDTARU").result
dfedtar = economic_indicators(series_id="DFEDTAR").result
fed_rate = ffill(coalesce(dfedtaru, dfedtar))

# SPY close
spy_close = src.c

# Timestamp
ts = index().value

# --- Cycle Detection ---
# A rate cut: current rate strictly below previous bar's rate
# fed_rate is ffill'd so it's constant between FOMC dates
# A cut occurs when the rate drops
prev_rate = fed_rate >> 1
is_cut = is_valid(fed_rate) and is_valid(prev_rate) and (fed_rate < prev_rate)

# Rate change on cut day (negative = cut)
rate_change = fed_rate - prev_rate

# Bars since last cut (on the bar BEFORE current)
# barssince returns 0 on the event bar itself
# So on a cut bar, (barssince(is_cut) >> 1) = bars since previous cut as of yesterday
bars_since_prev_cut = barssince(is_cut) >> 1

# New easing cycle: first cut after 252+ bars gap, or the very first cut ever
is_cycle_start = is_cut and (is_null(bars_since_prev_cut) or bars_since_prev_cut > 252)

# Filter to post-1990 only
post_1990 = ts >= Timestamp(value="1990-01-01")
is_cycle_start_filtered = is_cycle_start and post_1990

# --- Forward Returns ---
# 6-month (126 trading days) forward return of SPY
fwd_ret_126 = forward_returns(spy_close, 126)

# Forward return at cycle start dates only
cycle_fwd_ret = where(is_cycle_start_filtered, fwd_ret_126)

# Fed rate at cycle start
cycle_rate = where(is_cycle_start_filtered, fed_rate)

# Rate change at cycle start (in decimal, e.g. -0.25)
cycle_rate_change = where(is_cycle_start_filtered, rate_change)

# --- Labels ---
# Extract year for labeling
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# Build month name for event markers
month_name = conditional_select(
    month_num == 1, "Jan",
    month_num == 2, "Feb",
    month_num == 3, "Mar",
    month_num == 4, "Apr",
    month_num == 5, "May",
    month_num == 6, "Jun",
    month_num == 7, "Jul",
    month_num == 8, "Aug",
    month_num == 9, "Sep",
    month_num == 10, "Oct",
    month_num == 11, "Nov",
    "Dec"
)

# Year label for bar chart x-axis (use year as numeric label)
cycle_year = where(is_cycle_start_filtered, year_num)

# --- Event Markers: Cycle Start Events ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Easing Cycle Start",
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Month", type=CardRenderType.TextFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title="Fed Rate", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title="Rate Change (bps)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title="SPY 6M Return", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)((month_name, fed_rate, rate_change * 10000, fwd_ret_126, is_cycle_start_filtered))

# --- Bar Chart: Per-Cycle 6-Month SPY Return ---
# One bar per cycle year, color by value (green positive, red negative)
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title="SPY 6-Month Return After First Rate Cut of Each Easing Cycle",
    x_axis_label="Cycle Start Year",
    y_axis_label="6-Month Forward Return",
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Year,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    category="Easing Cycle Analysis",
    order=1
)(values=cycle_fwd_ret, label=cycle_year)

# --- Summary Table ---
# Per-cycle details: Date, Fed Rate, Rate Change, SPY Return
# Using standard mode with grid layout
# We show the key stats aggregated across events
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Easing Cycle Summary",
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=["Median", "Mean", "Count"],
        col_headers=["Fed Rate at Cut", "Rate Change (bps)", "SPY 6M Return", "Hit Rate (positive)"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category="Easing Cycle Analysis",
    order=2
)((
    cycle_rate / 100,
    cycle_rate_change * 10000,
    cycle_fwd_ret,
    where(is_cycle_start_filtered and is_valid(fwd_ret_126), 1.0 if fwd_ret_126 > 0 else 0.0),
    cycle_rate / 100,
    cycle_rate_change * 10000,
    cycle_fwd_ret,
    where(is_cycle_start_filtered and is_valid(fwd_ret_126), 1.0 if fwd_ret_126 > 0 else 0.0),
    cycle_rate / 100,
    cycle_rate_change * 10000,
    cycle_fwd_ret,
    where(is_cycle_start_filtered and is_valid(fwd_ret_126), 1.0 if fwd_ret_126 > 0 else 0.0)
))
